questions.question: On this day in 1889, which monarch was deposed in a military coup led by Deodoro da Fonseca, ending an empire and establishing a republic?
questions.explanation: Emperor Pedro II, the second and final ruler of the Empire of Brazil, was unseated by a coup that transformed the nation into a republic.
questions.context:
On this day in 1889: Brazilian emperor Pedro II was overthrown in a coup led by Deodoro da Fonseca (pictured), while the country was proclaimed a republic.
Pedro II of Brazil (Emperor of Brazil from 1831 to 1889): Dom Pedro II, known as "the Magnanimous", was the second and final emperor of the Empire of Brazil. He reigned from 1831 until his deposition in the military coup of 1889, presiding over the longest and most stable reign in Brazilian history.

questions.question: Which actor plays Ebenezer Scrooge in Ti West's 2026 Gothic horror comedy film adaptation of Charles Dickens's A Christmas Carol?
questions.explanation: Johnny Depp takes on the lead role of Scrooge in Ebenezer, directed by Ti West and adapted from Dickens's classic tale.
questions.context: Ebenezer (2026 film) (Film by Ti West): Ebenezer is a 2026 Gothic dark fantasy comedy horror film directed and co-edited by Ti West, written by Nathaniel Halpern based on the 1843 novella A Christmas Carol by Charles Dickens. The film stars Johnny Depp as Ebenezer Scrooge, alongside Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Tramell Tillman, and Ian McKellen.

questions.question: Which Canadian musician helped popularise female-led pop-punk during the early 2000s and has earned ten Juno Awards?
questions.explanation: Avril Lavigne is an acclaimed Canadian songwriter credited with expanding the mainstream appeal of punk-influenced pop in the early 2000s.
questions.context: Avril Lavigne (Canadian singer (born 1984)): Avril Ramona Lavigne is a Canadian singer and songwriter. She is credited with boosting the popularity of pop-punk music, in particular for female-driven, punk-influenced pop music in the early 2000s. Her accolades include 10 Juno Awards and eight Grammy Awards nominations.

questions.question: Which English comedian, recognized for his surreal humour, rose to fame during the late 1990s as a founding member of The Mighty Boosh?
questions.explanation: Noel Fielding established his comedy reputation with the surrealist troupe The Mighty Boosh before taking on numerous television hosting roles.
questions.context: Noel Fielding (British comedian (born 1973)): Noel Fielding is an English comedian, actor, writer, television personality and artist. Known for his dark and surreal comedic style, he gained prominence in the late 1990s as a member of the comedy troupe The Mighty Boosh.

questions.question: In which position does Welsh professional rugby union player James Botham play for Cardiff and the Wales national team?
questions.explanation: James Botham represents both United Rugby Championship outfit Cardiff and Wales playing in the flanker position.
questions.context: James Botham (Welsh rugby union player (born 1998)): James Ian Botham is a Welsh professional rugby union player who plays as a flanker for United Rugby Championship club Cardiff and the Wales national team.
